checks.description: Attempt 3: verified all 81 freeze manifest entries against commit cc677f6f4febc4ffaffc378aac2aea51a796be89. Every path, Git object, mode, type, and SHA-256 matched; commit tree 63c91885445d7f57d8ef442db79f87f45fc649a3 and manifest digest 43454d6d223a8637856121b193ca932d30e5f5ea9b43e3e5c1ee218dbdfe5037 matched. patch_sha256 is null in the freeze record.
Required toolchain: PATH included the Cargo bin directory; cargo --version reported cargo 1.95.0 (f2d3ce0bd 2026-03-21).

Clean scratch clone host gate: cargo xtask gate slice-1 --record <private run record>. macOS/aarch64, frozen commit, clean tree, rustc 1.95.0; fmt, Clippy, tests, guard, cargo deny, cargo audit, and Charter safety passed. Result green; 48 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. Each gate build step used a distinct target directory under /tmp/holden-mcp-qa1a3-target-host-final.
charter check --strict: charter: ok. It emitted only the existing slice-0 no-cost-row warning.

Clean frozen scratch clone Linux reopen: HOLDEN_VM_ADDR=192.168.64.10 cargo xtask gate slice-1 --linux-vm with tart absent from PATH. Linux/aarch64; fmt, Clippy, and tests passed; guard declared cargo-deny, cargo-audit, and Charter absent, and host gate covered those checks. Result green_with_declared_limitations; 48 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. Test names and counts matched the host exactly. seal_fixed_vector passed on both systems and asserts plan_commit bytes 2d368c47d0cdb02515b2225e1509a885844309a504f6c2109b5e525f014b8bb5. VM target directories were verified under /tmp/holden-mcp-qa1a3-target-vm.
M1: removed AAD from plan_commit in an isolated scratch clone; commit_binds_aad failed with mismatched commit bytes. Mutation was discarded.

M2: replaced authenticated decryption with raw XChaCha20 stream decryption that discards the Poly1305 tag. tampered_ciphertext_is_refused failed (PlanMalformed returned where TagRefused was required). Mutation was discarded.

M3: derived parameters as SHA-256(plan_commit || evaluated_commit), without the VRF secret. params_require_server_secret failed because different server keys produced identical parameters. Mutation was discarded.
M4: changed nonce open() to accept any nonce. uncommitted_nonce_is_refused failed with Ok(()) instead of NonceNotCommitted. Mutation was discarded.
M5: disabled the group/world mode check in key loading. world_readable_key_is_refused failed because an insecure key loaded successfully. Mutation was discarded.

M6: made resolve_addr ignore HOLDEN_VM_ADDR. vm_addr_override_skips_tart failed; a real cargo xtask gate slice-1 --linux-vm run with tart absent from PATH and HOLDEN_VM_ADDR set exited 1, refusing because tart ip returned no address. Mutation was discarded. The baseline VM gate above then passed.
Independent verifier P3 mutant: omitted evaluated_commit from the VRF transcript. params_depend_on_evaluated_commit failed. Mutation was discarded.

After mutant runs, reran cargo test --locked --workspace on the clean frozen scratch clone with its own target directory; all 48 tests passed. The earlier complete host gate also passed on the frozen bytes.
